title: Payment Exporter / Provider Operations
description: Payment Exporter 1.0.0 operations: freshness-aware HTTP state, observed probe success, latency, failure diagnostics, optional MTR and exporter health. Built-in panels only; no extra plugins or recording rules. HTTP status codes are not automatically treated as healthy/unhealthy.

options.content:
### PAYMENT PROVIDER OPERATIONS
Live HTTP health · exact status rules · select an instance or provider to investigate. **Gray / orange = unknown; not healthy.**

targets.expr: min(max by (job, instance) (up{job=~"${job:regex}", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}))

panels.description: افزایش تخمینی شمارندهٔ خطاها در بازهٔ انتخابی؛ صفر یعنی خطایی از این دسته مشاهده نشده. status=کد نامجاز، body=پاسخ ناقص، body_too_large=حجم بیش از حد، timeout=پایان مهلت.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (reason) (increase(payment_provider_probe_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}", instance=~"${instance:regex}", provider=~"${provider:regex}"}[$__range])))

panels.title: HTTP responses · ${__range}
panels.description: توزیع تخمینی کد پاسخ probeها. کد ۰ یعنی پاسخ قابل استفاده دریافت نشده. ۲۰۰ هم می‌تواند با خطای خواندن بدنه ناموفق باشد؛ ۴۰۱ یا ۴۰۴ هم می‌تواند طبق config سالم باشد. این نمودار به‌تنهایی سلامت را تعیین نمی‌کند.

panels.title: Failure rate by cause
panels.description: نرخ خطاهای probe در دقیقه به تفکیک علت؛ برای تشخیص تغییر الگوی timeout، TLS، شبکه یا کد پاسخ.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (rate(payment_provider_probe_errors_total{job=~"${job:regex}", instance=~"${instance:regex}", provider=~"${provider:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

panels.title: Probe rate

options.content: **No MTR data is expected when disabled.** MTR success measures whether the destination could be measured; it is independent of HTTP health. Loss and RTT gaps indicate missing/failed measurements, not zero loss. TCP checks use the URL port; ICMP may be filtered.

targets.expr: max by (job, instance, provider) (payment_provider_mtr_avg_latency_seconds{job=~"${job:regex}", instance=~"${instance:regex}", provider=~"${provider:regex}"}) and on (job, instance, provider) ((max by (job, instance, provider) (payment_provider_mtr_success{job=~"${job:regex}", instance=~"${instance:regex}", provider=~"${provider:regex}"}) and on (job, instance) (max by (job, instance) (up{job=~"${job:regex}", instance=~"${instance:regex}"}) == 1) and on (job, instance, provider) ((time() - max by (job, instance, provider) (payment_provider_last_probe_timestamp_seconds{job=~"${job:regex}", instance=~"${instance:regex}", provider=~"${provider:regex}"})) <= $freshness) and on (job, instance, provider) ((time() - max by (job, instance, provider) (payment_provider_last_probe_timestamp_seconds{job=~"${job:regex}", instance=~"${instance:regex}", provider=~"${provider:regex}"})) >= -5)) == 1)

options.content:
### Read the current state first
- **HEALTHY**: a fresh probe completed and returned one of the provider's configured status codes.
- **UNHEALTHY**: a fresh probe failed: unexpected status, timeout, TLS/network error, truncated or oversized body.
- **SCRAPE FAILED**: Prometheus cannot collect from the exporter. The provider state is unknown.
- **STALE / MISSING**: no trustworthy current result for a provider observed in the selected time range. This may include removed configuration entries.

### Interpret the numbers correctly
**Probe success** describes observed monitoring attempts, not transactions, business success, full uptime or an SLA. Missing scrapes are unknown. `increase()` extrapolates, so window counts are estimates. p95 is an estimate from histogram buckets and includes failed probes. HTTP 401/404 may be healthy; HTTP 200 with a body timeout is unhealthy. MTR is optional and independent.

### Filters & investigation
Select the Prometheus datasource, exporter job, instance and provider. Click a provider name in the status table to focus that provider and instance. **Freshness limit** defaults to 180 seconds; increase it for intentionally slow scrape intervals. A completion timestamp more than 5 seconds in the future is treated as untrustworthy. Jobs/providers are discovered from metrics; the exporter must have been scraped successfully at least once in the selected period.

**راهنمای کوتاه:** ابتدا State و Scrape health را بخوانید. دادهٔ قدیمی یا گپ به معنی سالم بودن نیست. سپس deadline، کد پاسخ و علت خطا را بررسی کنید. بخش‌های MTR و منابع exporter پیش‌فرض جمع شده‌اند؛ برای جزئیات بازشان کنید. Refresh فقط Prometheus را query می‌کند و مستقیماً probe جدید ایجاد نمی‌کند.
